interface.name: zwlr_gamma_control_manager_v1

description.summary: manager to create per-output gamma controls

interface.description: This interface is used to create gamma controls for outputs.

request.name: get_gamma_control

description.summary: get a gamma control for an output

request.description: Create a gamma control object for the supplied output.

interface.name: zwlr_gamma_control_v1

description.summary: adjust gamma tables for an output

interface.description: This interface adjusts the gamma tables for one output.

event.name: gamma_size
event.description: The size of the gamma ramps for this output.

request.name: set_gamma
request.description: Set the gamma table. The file descriptor must contain three unsigned 16-bit integer arrays of gamma_size length: red, green, and blue.

event.name: failed
event.description: The compositor can no longer honor this gamma control.
